scope: Two routing rounds produced after the D56 optimized round: (A) V1/V2 x ABCD experiment on the historical virtual-unfolded single-plane baseline (R=5 mm, 125 um edge gap); (B) femtosecond-laser-writing process (R>=40 mm fixed 40, 30 um edge gap) on the dual-height real IEC 2x16 interface model (row1->z1 opposite plane, row2->z2 adjacent plane, no z transition, cross-plane XY projections are not conflicts).

round_a.best: V1_B 462/1024 (45.12%); strict re-audit of historical 467 -> 465 legal

round_b.best: V2_C 694/1024 (67.77%); 16/16 planes strict PASS, 0 violations, router/validator mismatch=0; 22.3%(V1)/25.0%(V2) of adjacent-plane connections have no legal R=40 candidate (geometric limit)

honesty.dual_height: simulation under the two-height interface assumption; glass thickness and connector mounting direction are not confirmed; no z transition implemented; 9 mm connector pitch mechanical interference unresolved; not a claim of manufacturability
honesty.loss: propagation loss 0.05 dB/cm computed from analytic lengths; bend and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated; no invented optical numbers; no legacy polymer values used as glass truth
